messages:
alexa: Heads-up: CI microbench on my PR just failed with a weird kernel-affinity flip + prefetch plateau. Not a huge delta but exceeds threshold. Anyone around?

ci-bot: [CI] pr #20981 - microbench/kvcache_latency failed
ci-bot: metric: p95_latency  -> baseline 12.3ms, current 15.6ms (+26.8%) (threshold 20%)
ci-bot: diff: 
```
- baseline: 12.3
+ current: 15.6
threshold: 20% -> FAIL
```

matt: ugh. which commit in the PR?

alexa: the PR touches kernel-autoselect heuristics + tiny prefetch change. stack: allocator -> kernel selector -> kv-batcher.

sahil: can you paste the CI run id? want to pull traces.

alexa: run 7388880000-3 (linked in CI). here's the bench output snippet:
```
bench: kvcache_hit_latency
seq 64: baseline 12.3ms -> 15.6ms
hot path kernel: kernel_v2_autoselect
prefetch: enabled (timer window 8ms -> 12ms)
```

jen: quick repro: checkout alexa/pr-20981 then `scripts/bench/run_microbench --benchmark kvcache_hit_latency --iters 50` on a p4d-sim image. I ran locally, saw ~14.8ms p95. not as bad as CI.

samira: attaching a flamegraph from CI run (aws link): https://ci-artifacts/reports/7388880000/flamegraph.svg - looks like kernel selection spin up cost climbs during warmup.

kevin: sounds like warmup/prefetch window mismatch. If autoselect shifted kernels mid-warmup, KV hit working set might bounce. Could be our affinity threshold too aggressive.

matt: can we bisect to the exact commit? PR has 4 commits; i can try reverting the kernel-autoselect change locally.

sahil: i pulled CI perf traces — the KV batcher shows repeated evict/rehit at ~8s mark, correlates with the kernel switch.

alexa: repro command to capture traces: `LD_PRELOAD=libprof.so MICROBENCH_PROFILE=1 scripts/bench/run_microbench ...`

matt: quick revert of just the kernel-autoselect patch on my machine brought p95 back to 12.6ms (50 iters). confirming locally.

jen: would prefer a targeted revert/patch rather than full rollback if this blocks rollout.

samira: looks like kernel_v2 has slightly higher warmup tail for certain seqlen distributions. autoselect prob pushes v2 when batch timer spikes.

kevin: suggestion: temporarily clamp autoselect probability to prefer kernel_v1 for warmup duration (eg first 10s) and re-run CI. low-risk quirk.

alexa: agree. matt can you open a follow-up PR with the clamp? mark as hotfix and trigger CI?

matt: on it. will push `pr-20981-hotfix-clamp` in 15m.

sahil: once CI runs, i'll watch the kvcache traces and the kernel switch timeline.

alexa: thanks all. tagging @eng-oncall in case we need emergency revert on rollout. :thumbsup:
